text: {"reason":"Add a high-confidence gate. V1 had 28 arbitrations, including 20 false ones (FAR 0.714) with recall 1.0. Six of the eight displayed false positives have confidence below 0.70, so this single condition removes those errors while retaining the existing magnitude, exposure, and frozen-horizon protections, aiming to preserve recall ≥0.8.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure) (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15) (> inventory-exposure 500000) (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change)) (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
